objects.description: During [Cutting Edge](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0029), threat actors trojanized legitimate files in Ivanti Connect Secure appliances with malicious code.(Citation: Mandiant Cutting Edge January 2024)(Citation: Volexity Ivanti Zero-Day Exploitation January 2024)(Citation: Mandiant Cutting Edge Part 2 January 2024)
